html:
Trees use nested [value,left,right] lists; an empty subtree is None. Values are integers. Return whether every left descendant is strictly smaller and every right descendant strictly larger than its ancestor; duplicates are invalid.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      5,
      [
        2,
        null,
        null
      ],
      [
        9,
        [
          7,
          null,
          null
        ],
        null
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": true
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      5,
      [
        2,
        null,
        [
          6,
          null,
          null
        ]
      ],
      null
    ]
  ],
  "expected": false
}
Hint

Pass ancestor bounds down the recursion.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(h) space
